Polynomial quadratic-similitude saturation is now an additional global gate: if q composed with an ambient polynomial automorphism is a*q, undo it in the same source parameters before classifying retained projections or hyperplane images. METHOD-HC4-AFFINE-POLAR-SEMISIMPLE-20261.title: Count polar ramification and true infinity branches; use whole Witt strata to close all invertible semisimple affine offsets
METHOD-HC4-AFFINE-POLAR-SEMISIMPLE-20261.when: Repeated eigenvalues or isotropic eigenspace projections evade a marked Krylov reciprocal-Hessian budget in a four-variable affine quadratic-composite graph.
METHOD-HC4-AFFINE-POLAR-SEMISIMPLE-20261.use: First normalize the two plane quadrics literally. Their affine polar conic has degree-4d level map and weighted infinity branches give positive total genus without a connectedness assertion. For a nonzero isotropic projection choose a full-eigenspace Witt pair and keep both x!=0 and x=0 strata; use every scalar low-genus exception and its actual critical count.
